claims.text: N. meningitidis is a common, significant cause of community-acquired bacterial meningitis in the US.
claims.byte_quote: N meningitidis_ is a common and significant cause of community-acquired bacterial meningitis in the US

claims.text: N. meningitidis is the second most common cause of community-acquired bacterial meningitis in adults, after Streptococcus pneumoniae.
claims.byte_quote: it is the second most common cause of community-acquired bacterial meningitis in adults after _Streptococcus pneumoniae_

claims.text: Meningococcal disease incidence fell from 1.2/100,000 in 1996 to 0.1/100,000 in 2018.
claims.byte_quote: The incidence has decreased from 1.2 cases per 100,000 individuals in 1996 to 0.1 cases per 100,000 individuals in 2018

claims.text: Highest meningococcal disease incidence is in infants younger than 1 year (2.45 cases per 100,000).
claims.byte_quote: The highest incidence of meningococcal disease appears in infants younger than 1 year of age, with 2.45 cases reported per 100,000 individuals

claims.text: Serotypes A, B, C, W, X, and Y are responsible for most meningococcal infections.
claims.byte_quote: serotypes A, B, C, W, X, and Y responsible for most meningococcal infections

claims.text: Serotypes B, C, and Y are the main disease-causing serotypes in Europe, the US, and Canada.
claims.byte_quote: Serotypes B, C, and Y are the main serotypes causing disease in Europe, the United States (US), and Canada

claims.text: Meningococcal disease primarily affects children and young adults.
claims.byte_quote: This condition primarily affects children and young adults

claims.text: Risk factors for meningococcal carriage include adolescence/young adulthood, male sex, living in a communal setting, and exposure to cigarette smoke.
claims.byte_quote: Risk factors for meningococcal carriage include adolescence and young adulthood, male sex, living in a communal setting, exposure to cigarette smoke

claims.text: Immunocompromising conditions raising meningococcal risk include HIV, AIDS, asplenia, and complement deficiencies.
claims.byte_quote: These conditions include human immunodeficiency virus infection, acquired immune deficiency syndrome, asplenia, and complement deficiencies

claims.text: Nasopharyngeal colonization raises transmission risk to close contacts such as family members, college roommates, and military recruits.
claims.byte_quote: Nasopharyngeal colonization increases the risk of transmission to individuals in close contact with infected patients, such as family members, college roommates, and military recruits

claims.text: N. meningitidis is an aerobic or facultative anaerobic gram-negative diplococcus.
claims.byte_quote: N meningitidis_ is an aerobic or facultative anaerobic, gram-negative diplococcus

claims.text: Gram staining is diagnostic in 85% of patients with meningococcal meningitis.
